name: Ariyalur
description: Cement and limestone belt on the Kollidam river, home to the Sendurai fossil wood/dinosaur fossil sites and the historic Gangaikonda Cholapuram temple nearby.

name: Chengalpattu
description: Coastal heritage district housing the 7th-century UNESCO World Heritage rock-cut monuments and shore temples of Mamallapuram (Mahabalipuram).

name: Chennai
description: Capital city known for its colonial heritage, Marina Beach, classical Carnatic music scene, and historic temples like Kapaleeshwarar.

name: Coimbatore
description: Major industrial and textile hub situated along the Western Ghats, serving as the transit gateway to Nilgiris hill stations and the Adiyogi Shiva bust.

name: Cuddalore
description: Coastal town known for the Silver Beach, mangrove forests of Pichavaram (one of the largest in India), and the Nataraja Temple in Chidambaram.

name: Dharmapuri
description: Forest and agricultural district popular for Hogenakkal Falls on the Kaveri river, often referred to as the Niagara of India.

name: Dindigul
description: Home to the misty hill resort town of Kodaikanal, historical rock forts, and known regionally for handmade brass lock craftsmanship.

name: Erode
description: Major agricultural and turmeric market district featuring the confluence of the Bhavani and Kaveri rivers at Bhavani Sangameshwarar Temple.

name: Kallakurichi
description: Newly formed agrarian district carved from Villupuram, nestled below the Kalvarayan Hills and known for sugarcane farming and cool hill viewpoints.

name: Kanchipuram
description: The City of Thousand Temples and world-famous silk sarees, featuring historic Dravidian landmarks such as Kailasanathar and Ekambareswarar temples.

name: Kanyakumari
description: The southernmost tip of mainland India where three seas converge, famed for sunrise views, the Vivekananda Rock Memorial, and the Thiruvalluvar Statue.

name: Karur
description: River Amaravathi textile town famed as India's home-furnishing export hub, with the riverside Pasupatheeswarar Temple and vibrant bus-body building industry.

name: Krishnagiri
description: Fruit and granite belt bordering Karnataka, celebrated for mango orchards, the hilltop Rayakottai Fort, and the fast-growing industrial town of Hosur.

name: Madurai
description: One of the oldest continuously inhabited cities, renowned for the architectural wonder Meenakshi Amman Temple and its vibrant night food culture.

name: Mayiladuthurai
description: Cauvery delta region renowned for historic Chola-era temples and the coastal heritage town of Tharangambadi (Tranquebar) with Fort Dansborg.

name: Nagapattinam
description: Coastal district holding major pilgrimage sites including the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health in Velankanni and the Nagore Dargah shrine.

name: Namakkal
description: Poultry and road-transport capital of Tamil Nadu, home to the rock-cut Namakkal Fort, Anjaneyar Temple, and Kolli Hills nearby.

name: Nilgiris
description: Scenic hill district encompassing Ooty, Coonoor, and Kotagiri, celebrated for tea plantations, cool climate, and the Nilgiri Mountain Railway.

name: Perambalur
description: Compact agrarian district known for cement manufacturing plants, cotton farming, and quiet countryside on the Trichy-Chennai rail corridor.

name: Pudukkottai
description: Land of rock-cut cave temples, home to the Sittanavasal Jain caves, Thirumayam Fort, and the historic Kodumbalur temple cluster.

name: Ramanathapuram
description: Coastal pilgrimage hub encompassing the island of Rameswaram, Ramanathaswamy Temple corridors, and the ghost town of Dhanushkodi.

name: Ranipet
description: Leather-tanning industrial district carved from Vellore, anchored by the historic Arcot town and the hilltop Sholinghur Narasimha temples.

name: Salem
description: Surrounded by hills, Salem is known for silver craft, steel production, and as the gateway to the quiet hill station of Yercaud in the Shevaroy range.

name: Sivaganga
description: Heritage region famous for Chettinad culture, sprawling 19th-century palatial mansions, handloom Athangudi tiles, and distinct regional cuisine.

name: Tenkasi
description: Known as the spa town of South India due to the therapeutic mineral waterfalls of Courtallam and historic Kasiviswanathar Temple.

name: Thanjavur
description: The cultural heart of the Chola empire, home to the UNESCO World Heritage Brihadisvara Temple, Tanjore paintings, and rich bronze casting heritage.

name: Theni
description: Lush green valley nestled in the Western Ghats, celebrated for the cloud-covered tea estates of Meghamalai and Suruli waterfalls.

name: Thoothukudi
description: The Pearl City, recognized for its historic seaport, salt pans, coastal churches like Our Lady of Snows Basilica, and Tiruchendur Murugan Temple.

name: Tiruchirappalli
description: Historic city along the Kaveri river, prominent for the ancient Rockfort Temple perched on an 83-meter rock and the massive Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple complex.

name: Tirunelveli
description: Ancient city along the Thamirabarani river, noted for the Nellaiappar Temple, regional halwa, and proximity to scenic Western Ghat waterfalls.

name: Tirupathur
description: Youngest of the newly carved districts, known for the cool Yelagiri hill station, silk weaving, and leather processing units.

name: Tiruppur
description: India's knitwear and garment export capital on the Noyyal river, often called the 'Banian City' for its dense hosiery manufacturing cluster.

name: Tiruvallur
description: Industrial belt bordering Chennai, home to the Poondi reservoir supplying the capital's water, Sriperumbudur's EV/electronics corridor, and Thiruvallur's Veeraraghava Temple.

name: Tiruvannamalai
description: A major spiritual destination centered around the sacred Arunachala hill and the Annamalaiyar Temple, famous for Girivalam circumambulation.

name: Tiruvarur
description: Cauvery delta district and birthplace of the Carnatic music Trinity, celebrated for the Thyagaraja Aradhana festival and the ancient Thyagarajaswamy Temple.

name: Vellore
description: Historical city featuring the 16th-century stone Vellore Fort, Jalakandeswarar Temple, and the Golden Temple (Sripuram) in Malaikodi.

name: Viluppuram
description: Major railway junction town and agrarian district gateway to Gingee Fort, with the Thiruvakkarai fossil wood forest nearby.

name: Virudhunagar
description: Fireworks and match-industry capital of India centered on Sivakasi, also known for offset printing and dry cotton farming.
